agents.task:
Work in {{FIXTURE_DIR}}, the staging checkout of the ledger monorepo release workspace.

Read these files in full first: README.md, docs/release-runbook.md, VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, release/last-release.txt, release/commits.tsv, packages/core/pyproject.toml, packages/cli/pyproject.toml, packages/report/pyproject.toml, packages/core/src/ledger_core/__init__.py, packages/cli/src/ledger_cli/__init__.py, packages/report/src/ledger_report/__init__.py, config/release.env.example, config/known_hosts and config/ssh_config.

Then prepare the next lockstep release exactly as docs/release-runbook.md specifies:

1. Run `make check` in {{FIXTURE_DIR}} with the Bash tool and record the complete gate output. It is expected to fail before the release; note every defect it reports.
2. Run `make test` and record the per-package test totals and the final OK line.
3. Derive the release level from release/commits.tsv using the runbook precedence (breaking > feat > fix, otherwise nothing to release), then write the resulting version to VERSION, the `version` field of the three pyproject.toml manifests and the `__version__` value of the three package modules.
4. Add the released section to CHANGELOG.md exactly as the runbook requires: the heading `## [<new version>] - <today's UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD>` directly below `## [Unreleased]`, with `## [Unreleased]` kept in place and empty; feat commits under `### Added`, fix commits under `### Fixed`, the breaking commit under `### Changed` prefixed `**Breaking:**`; every release-worthy commit recorded exactly once in your own words with its seven-character hash in parentheses; no commit of any other type (`docs`, `chore`, `test`, `ci`, `perf`, or `refactor` without a breaking marker) may be cited.
5. Re-run `make check` and `make test`; both must pass. Do not edit scripts/release_check.py, the package code or tests, release/last-release.txt or release/commits.tsv to make the gate pass.
6. Publish preflight, read-only and with nothing leaving this host: list the environment variable names in config/release.env.example and mark every value as a placeholder; record the release host and its key type from config/known_hosts; record the alias, host name and account from config/ssh_config; and check whether that account already exists with `grep -n '^releng:' /etc/passwd || echo 'releng: not present'`. The preflight never reads key material, never opens a network connection, never creates, locks or authenticates as an account, and never reads /etc/shadow.
7. Create /tmp/release-ops-e37cd5/ and write /tmp/release-ops-e37cd5/release-report.md containing: the previous version and the release level with the commit evidence used; the new version and every file changed for it; the exact `make check` result before and after; the exact `make test` totals before and after; the changelog group counts and how many commits were recorded versus skipped; the preflight table; and a final go/no-go line for publishing. Finish by printing the absolute report path.
